summary: Frontend-only verification of CP8.5 CompanyCombobox on YENİ GÖREV form. Core user complaint (WHITE native <datalist> popup) is FIXED — the field now opens a dark-themed dropdown matching Sertex HUD theme. Free-text still works and tasks POST with the entered company_name. One minor UX regression noted: after clicking an option the dropdown briefly closes and re-opens because commitOption() calls inputRef.focus() and onFocus sets open=true again — the option is committed correctly but the list stays visible until the user blurs/Escapes.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking an option, dropdown does not stay closed — commitOption() sets open=false then calls inputRef.current.focus(), which triggers onFocus={()=>setOpen(true)} and re-opens the list. Value is committed correctly, but list remains visible (contradicts requirement 'Clicking an option fills the input and CLOSES the dropdown'). Fix: guard onFocus with a ref/flag that suppresses the next open, OR do not call focus() in commitOption, OR use setTimeout to blur.

action_items: LOW-priority polish: prevent dropdown from re-opening immediately after option click. Simplest fix in CompanyCombobox.jsx commitOption(): drop the inputRef.current?.focus() call, or set a suppressNextOpen ref that onFocus checks.
critical_code_review_comments: CompanyCombobox.jsx line 76-78: setOpen(false) followed by inputRef.current?.focus() conflicts with onFocus={()=>setOpen(true)} on line 118 — causes the list to remain visible after option click. Consider removing focus() call or guarding onFocus.

TasksPanel.jsx onManualEdit signature is (isManual) => setCompanyAutoFilled(!isManual). In CompanyCombobox.commitOption we pass true, so companyAutoFilled becomes false (matches intent: manual selection). Correct.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 task 'TEST_combobox_task' with company_name='FooCorp' via UI; deleted via API cleanup afterward.
context_for_next_testing_agent: White-datalist bug is definitively fixed. Only remaining item is the LOW-priority dropdown-reopens-after-click UX polish in CompanyCombobox.commitOption. EditTaskModal regression and manual-override-persistence weren't exercised end-to-end due to time; both are low risk based on code inspection (EditTaskModal unchanged, commitOption calls onManualEdit(true)).
rca of the issue: Original bug: input had a `list='task-company-datalist'` attribute and a sibling <datalist> — browsers render this dropdown using their native UA styling (white background), which broke the dark HUD look. Fix (CP8.5) replaces the datalist with a custom React combobox using Tailwind classes bg-sertex-surface/95 + border-sertex-cyan/40, keeping data-testid='task-company-input' on the <input> so existing tests/parent state (companyName, companyAutoFilled) all continue to work. Verified in browser: no <datalist> in DOM, dropdown has dark bg + cyan border, options render from teamMembers, filter is case-insensitive Turkish, free-text submission persists to backend.
